Runs one SerchaQL statement or script as the caller. A SELECT returns rows; SHOW and DESCRIBE return their listings; DDL needs an admin. describe serchaql (MCP) or the SerchaQL reference lists what the language accepts. With ?explain=true the plan is returned instead of rows.
